name: Bronte Hughes
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with her father's vintage Holden. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for engineering and a desire to push the boundaries of automotive performance. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering, she started her career in a small racing team, where she quickly gained a reputation for her meticulous attention to detail and relentless pursuit of improvement.

As a chief engineer, Bronte believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work. She combines a data-driven approach with an intuitive understanding of vehicle dynamics, constantly seeking innovative solutions to optimize performance. While demanding, her loyalty to her team and commitment to excellence make her a valuable asset. Bronte is known for her ability to see the 'big picture' and identify key areas for improvement, even under pressure.
